run_query: run the query function to send an image to fal-ai API for image-to-image transformation
create_query_function: create a query function that reads an image file, encodes it to base64, and posts it to the fal-ai API
test_query: test the query function with a sample image input and prompt for image-to-image generation
refactor_query: refactor the query function to support configurable API URL and headers
review_query: review the query function and its usage of requests.post to call the fal-ai image-to-image endpoint
